```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(BGLR)
```

# Y = E + G + e

## GBLUP

### Yield

```{r}
load("EZ.rda")
load("GDec.rda")

y <- readxl::read_excel("Y_CV.xlsx") %>% pull(yield)

ETA <- list(
  list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
  list(V = GDec$vectors, d = GDec$values, model = "RKHS")
)

set.seed(1)

modelo <- BGLR(
  y = y,
  ETA = ETA,
  nIter = 20000,
  burnIn = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

save(modelo, file = "GBLUP_Yield_G.rda")

rm(list = ls())
```

## Components

```{r}
load("GBLUP_Yield_G.rda")

var_e <- modelo$varE
var_g <- var(modelo$ETA[[2]]$u)
h2 <- var_g / (var_g + var_e)

comp_y <- data.frame(G = var_g,
                     e = var_e,
                     herd = h2,
                     trait = "yield")

load("GBLUP_Protein_G.rda")

var_e <- modelo$varE
var_g <- var(modelo$ETA[[2]]$u)
h2 <- var_g / (var_g + var_e)

comp_p <- data.frame(G = var_g,
                     e = var_e,
                     herd = h2,
                     trait = "protein")

load("GBLUP_Oil_G.rda")

var_e <- modelo$varE
var_g <- var(modelo$ETA[[2]]$u)
h2 <- var_g / (var_g + var_e)

comp_o <- data.frame(G = var_g,
                     e = var_e,
                     herd = h2,
                     trait = "oil")

gblup <- rbind(comp_y, comp_p, comp_o)

gblup$model <- "GBLUP"
gblup$eff <- "Main Effects"

h2 <- var_g / (var_g + var_e)

h2 <- var_g / (var_g + var_e)

comp_o <- data.frame(G = var_g,
                     e = var_e,
                     herd = h2,
                     trait = "oil")

poly <- rbind(comp_y, comp_p, comp_o)

poly$model <- "Polynomial"
poly$eff <- "Main Effects"

data <- rbind(gblup, lpc, gauss, bsl, poly)

writexl::write_xlsx(data, "VarCompG.xlsx")
```

# Y = E + G + GxE + e

## GBLUP

### Yield

```{r}
load("EZ.rda")
load("GDec.rda")
load("GxEDec.rda")

y <- readxl::read_excel("Y_CV.xlsx") %>% pull(yield)

ETA <- list(
  list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
  list(V = GDec$vectors, d = GDec$values, model = "RKHS"),
  list(V = GxEDec$vectors, d = GxEDec$values, model = 'RKHS')
)

set.seed(1)

modelo <- BGLR(
  y = y,
  ETA = ETA,
  nIter = 20000,
  burnIn = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

save(modelo, file = "GBLUP_Yield_GxE.rda")

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
load("GxEDec_poly.rda")

y <- readxl::read_excel("Y_CV.xlsx") %>% pull(protein)

ETA <- list(
  list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
  list(V = GDec$vectors, d = GDec$values, model = "RKHS"),
  list(V = GxEDec$vectors, d = GxEDec$values, model = 'RKHS')
)

set.seed(1)

modelo <- BGLR(
  y = y,
  ETA = ETA,
  nIter = 20000,
  burnIn = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

save(modelo, file = "POLY_Protein_GxE.rda")

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
)

set.seed(1)
```
